## Changes

The material was reformatted and changed: it was retrieved through the Open5e API (https://api.open5e.com) and mapped to this project's monster schema (field names, structure and grouping differ from the original). The generator is `scripts/import-srd.ts`.

`difficulty.json` (the XP by challenge rating and XP budget per character tables) is not from Open5e. Its numbers were transcribed by hand from the SRD 5.2 text, the "Experience Points by Challenge Rating" table (`SRD_CC_v5.2.pdf` page 253, `SRD_CC_v5.2.1.pdf` page 256) and the "XP Budget per Character" table (page 202), as published in public CC-BY Markdown copies of the SRD text; the PDF itself was not read. For CR 0 the SRD says "0 or 10" XP; the file uses 10.
